arm_definitions.A_text: Source bundle and static full artifact extraction only. One model request.
arm_definitions.B_fixed_inspection: A plus predetermined complete rendered views and recorded recalculation results. One model request. Evidence preparation is not yet a completed grader run.
arm_definitions.C_agentic: Same starting evidence as B plus read-only follow-up inspection of the same source/artifact universe. Up to four model requests including final verdict. Recalculate/render disposable copies; never repair graded artifacts.

shared_final_output: Per-criterion pass/fail/uncertain, exact evidence locations, short rationale, counterevidence, consequence and minimum correction. Separately report visual/recalculation check pass/fail/unknown; do not fabricate an overall human acceptance score.
pre_execution_gates: Human checks all four source/output pairs; uncertain or inadequate cases remain unresolved.
Lossless evidence validator checked on multiline and artifact attribution cases.
Freeze matched B evidence, renderer/calculation-engine versions and hashes.
Implement and dry-run bounded inspection runner; keep author keys and reviewer labels outside judge access.
Check actual account balance; measure one agentic session cost before the remainder.

analysis.unit: Two source scenario blocks, with two cases each; 12 sessions are not 12 independent business tasks.
comparisons: B minus A: diagnostic of extra supplied inspection evidence.
C minus B: value of adaptive follow-up, confounded with extra compute and any extra retrieved evidence.
analysis.follow_up_if_C_improves: Replay C-gathered evidence to a static judge as a separately planned extension before claiming agency itself caused the gain.

relationship_to_existing_plan: This is the next optional extension, not an automatic addition to every previously discussed schedule. Retain judge_controls_11 40-request wording/repeat/self-review schedule as deferred. The conversational 32-call control proposal is not also scheduled here.
budget_policy: This preparation script launches no paid calls. Prior one-shot cost estimates do not cover images, tool context or multi-turn sessions. Price a bounded pilot before scaling; record unresolved charges separately.
